points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Seven steady packages pass structural validator; Re200 final metadata absent and all NACA laminar wall Cf values are zero.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Official seven steady cases passed structural validation; Re200 fails on missing metadata. Structural pass is not numerical acceptance.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Seven residual targets met with bounded late force tails; Re200 pending, and physical credibility of zero NACA shear and Re20 drag is poor.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Re20 CD5.482 vs ~2; NACA viscous forces/Cf zero, subsonic inviscid CD0.066 excessive. Rank comparison alone does not establish accuracy.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Accepted 22-page PDF has per-case force/residual and field panels, but full-domain contours shrink body and wake to a few pixels.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Report acknowledges missing Re200 and excessive drag, but falsely says all production reconstruction is second order and full-traction force is skin friction.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Accepted sibling PDF matches tracked TeX and provides tables/figures; source figures are uncommitted and exact historical binary/image binding remains qualified.

disqualification_flags.flag: Figure files misnamed (e.g., Mach image that actually plots pressure)
Report figures do not correspond to submitted field/CSV outputs
Placeholder, synthetic, or intentionally partial result files in scored case dirs
metadata.json marks incomplete or failed runs as successful
Debug outputs presented as final case results
